question: Which of the following Committees is a Standing Committee of the Parliament?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Public Accounts Committee**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Public Accounts Committee (PAC)** is one of the most important **Standing Committees** of the Indian Parliament.
 
• It was first constituted in **1921** under the provisions of the **Government of India Act, 1919**.
 
• The PAC examines the **appropriation accounts** and the **finance accounts** of the Government of India and scrutinizes the reports of the Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG).
 
• The committee consists of **22 members**: **15 from Lok Sabha** and **7 from Rajya Sabha**. Members are elected annually by Parliament.
